Halloween theme

A first look at the colours, fonts and pieces, to decide on before building it into the app. Cute on the whole, with a few creepy surprises. Everything you see here is drawn in code and the sounds are made on the spot, so nothing comes from anywhere else.

Things to try: click the pumpkin by the app's name (trick or treat?), point at the bats, the spider and the pumpkins in the patch, and keep an eye on the tombstones.

Home

The spotlight sits over a pumpkin patch at night: a haunted house on the hill under a big moon, tombstones, a crooked fence with a black cat, and fog drifting past. Embers float up instead of snow falling. The left side stays calm, for the text.

Fonts

Titles get a spooky font (pick one, it changes the whole page), everything else stays easy to read in Baloo 2, round and friendly. All of them are free to use.

Sounds

Made on the spot by the app, like Snowdin's.

The plan

  • 1. The look: colours, fonts, rounded shapes and glows on every screen.
  • 2. Sounds: the organ, the door, the cauldron, the ghost.
  • 3. The top bar: the pumpkin by the name (trick or treat), the branch with bats, the spider.
  • 4. Covers: each title's own little friend.
  • 5. The scenes: the pumpkin patch under the spotlight, a graveyard path on show pages, fog and embers.
  • 6. The surprises: the ghost behind the tombstones, the cat on the fence, pumpkins that glow, the candle snuffed out when you press Play.
  • 7. Halloween night: extra pumpkins and a few more surprises on 31 October.
  • 8. Checking every screen: player, settings, the small preview in Appearance.
